faq_section.title: Your questions,
faq_section.subtitle: Everything you need to know about learning English through Vietnamese cultural heritage.

faq1.question: How is VieCultures different from traditional English learning apps?
faq1.answer: Instead of generic Western texts, VieCultures anchors lessons to authentic Vietnamese heritage — food, craft villages, history, and customs. Learners build vocabulary to express Vietnamese identity naturally on global stages.

faq2.question: How do bilingual reading and one-tap word lookup work?
faq2.answer: Every story has aligned parallel sentences in Vietnamese and English. Tap any word to view its IPA pronunciation, part of speech, Vietnamese definition, and context sentence, with variable audio speeds (0.75x–1.5x).

faq3.question: How does spaced repetition (SRS) help you remember words?
faq3.answer: VieCultures adapts the proven SM-2 algorithm. Rate your recall after each card to schedule reviews at optimal memory intervals, converting short-term recognition into lasting active recall.

faq4.question: How does synchronized audio shadowing improve pronunciation?
faq4.answer: Synchronized native-speaker recordings let you shadow phrase by phrase. Focus on natural sentence stress, intonation, and connected speech to speak English with authentic rhythm.

faq5.question: What is Safe Reflections?
faq5.answer: Safe Reflections is a supportive space where learners write reflections about cultural stories without anxiety over constant red marks. Encouragement and genuine expression come first.

faq6.question: Can I start learning with VieCultures for free?
faq6.answer: Yes. Featured stories, bilingual reader, vocabulary lookups, and the core review deck are free to explore. Create an account to save your learning history and streaks.
